messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning to enable `cetus-11b-quant` in the model catalog during the 02:00-03:00 UTC change window tonight. Objectives: preserve latency SLO, avoid traffic churn, and ensure fallback ordering is by success_rate then p99.
maria: Can we pin legacy-11b so traffic doesn't shift unexpectedly? thinking reserved 20% to be safe.
alex: Yes. We'll reserve legacy-11b=20% and put the new model behind a phased ramp: 1% canary -> 5% -> 20% steady over ~60m. Also enforce rollback thresholds.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: `catalog.enable(cetus-11b-quant)` window=02:00-03:00 UTC canary=[1%->5%->20%] rollback_if: error_rate>1.5% OR p99_latency>1.2x_baseline. Ops hooks enabled.
sam: Add churn-control: throttle ramp if token-rate spike >1.3x baseline (we saw churn issues last month).
jia: Suggest fallback ladder: `cetus-11b-quant -> cetus-11b-fp16 -> legacy-11b -> fallback-small`. Tie quality monitors to the `dialog-smoke` eval set.
ops-bot: Pin applied: `legacy-11b=reserved:20%`. Runbook created: https://intranet/release/runbooks/cetus-cutover. Checklist auto-generated.
alex: Quick rollout snippet for the runbook (paste-ready):
```
rollout:
  - phase: canary
    pct: 1
    wait: 10m
  - phase: ramp
    pct: 5
    wait: 20m
  - phase: steady
    pct: 20
    wait: 30m
conditions:
  - rollback_on: error_rate>1.5%
  - rollback_on: p99_latency>baseline*1.2
  - hold_if: observed_churn>1.25x
metrics:
  - eval_set: dialog-smoke
  - latency_slo: p99
```
maria: Do we need to tweak cache TTLs? prefix/KV cache might take a while to warm, could affect canary success.
sam: Let's enable prefill: `cache.ttl_prefill=true` at canary start and scale up workers slowly. I'll watch for evictions.
deploy-bot: Approvals requested: @maria @sam @jia — reply `+1` to approve the rollout.
maria: +1 :thumbsup:
sam: +1
jia: +1 — will monitor dialog-smoke and surface any quality regressions.
alex: Final rule: if eval regression >2% or any safety alert hits, immediate rollback. I'll be oncall and watching dashboards.
ops-bot: Cutover checklist snapshot: 1) reserve/pin legacy-11b 2) schedule enable with phased ramp 3) enable churn-control & prefill cache 4) watch eval + latency gates 5) rollback on triggers. Issue: https://intranet/issues/RELEASE-4321
sam: I'll keep an eye on autoscale slots and eviction noise — ping me if eviction_rate>3%.
alex: Thanks — will post post-deploy summary here and close the thread after the rollout."
